Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1040
Claimant:
James Castillo
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2023-07-30
Claim received for a left-turn collision at an intersection, with the insured's vehicle struck while the claimant was
turning across oncoming traffic. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will route through the
attorney's office.
2023-07-31
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The other driver's statement mathces the claimant's
account, and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and the collision occurred as
described.
2023-08-14
Inspected the vehicle with the appraiser. The damage pattern lines up with the imapct described, and the repair
estimate reflects only what this collision would produce.
2023-08-26
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file points
to prior damage to this vehicle, and the prior-loss history is clean.
2023-10-19
Received the initial medical report documenting whiplash. The injury is consistent with the mechanism of a side
impact of this kind, and the claimant has no rceord of prior complaints involving the same area of the body.
2023-10-26
Treatment began with a physical therapy plan and followed the usual course for soft-tissue neck injuries. Notes show
steady improvement, and visit frequency has tapered as the claimant's symptoms eased.
2023-11-10
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the treatment records. The account given to the attorney matches
what the claimant told me in our earlier calls, with no changes to the sequence or the description of the collision.
2023-12-16
Reviewed the file with the supervisor. All sources agree on how the accident occurred and on the claimant's presence
in the vehicle, and the medical course and vehicle damage fit the reported loss. Claim remains open pending final
treatment summary.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
